description: Answers to schools’ questions about Planner.

questions.question: Where is our data stored?
questions.reponse: Ask where your school’s data will be hosted. We will explain the terms of the offer.

questions.question: Which languages is the site available in?
questions.reponse: The site is available in French and English. Contact us to find out which languages are available in the applications you are interested in.

questions.question: Can we import lists?
questions.reponse: Administrators can import lists of accounts, students and teachers from compatible CSV files.

questions.question: What does the mobile app offer?
questions.reponse: The student app shows the week’s classes, scans the attendance QR code and opens the library. Without a phone, students can open their timetable and resources in a browser, and the teacher can record attendance manually.

questions.question: How is AI used?
questions.reponse: When AI is turned on for your school in the quiz Studio, it can suggest questions that the teacher reviews before sharing them.

questions.question: Can we choose StudyLib separately?
questions.reponse: Contact us to discuss StudyLib and the features that meet your school’s needs.

questions.question: How much does it cost?
questions.reponse: Contact us to discuss your school’s needs.
